description: Grade a web response's security headers from header text you paste (nothing is fetched). Six checks, each read the way its standard says a browser reads it: Strict-Transport-Security (RFC 6797), Content-Security-Policy basics (CSP Level 3: script sources, 'unsafe-inline', wildcards, 'unsafe-eval'), X-Content-Type-Options, framing (CSP frame-ancestors, else X-Frame-Options), Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, against the OWASP Secure Headers Project list (dated 2026-10-18). Get back pass, weak, fail or missing per check with the reason, a letter grade, headers that leak server details, and the other OWASP-list headers not set. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/security-headers-check). Not legal, tax or financial advice.

headers.description: The HTML page's response header lines as text, one 'Name: value' per line (a status line first is skipped). Values of headers other than the graded ones are never echoed.

scheme.description: Whether the response came over https (default) or plain http (browsers ignore HSTS over http).
